description: This is a test class for the CredentialsApiAuthProvider, verifying its behavior with various scenarios including failure cases, malformed credentials, non-existing auth ID, and disabled credentials. The class uses JUnit with Vertx testing utilities and mocks related dependencies to test the authentication logic.

classes.name: CredentialsApiAuthProviderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CredentialsApiAuthProvider, testing various authentication failure and success scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, mocks dependencies, and creates an instance of the provider before each test.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsWithExceptionReportedByCredentialsClient
methods.description: Tests that the provider propagates an exception from the credentials client during authentication.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsWith401ForMalformedCredentials
methods.description: Tests that malformed credentials lead to an unauthorized error.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsWith401ForNonExistingAuthId
methods.description: Tests that an unknown auth ID results in an unauthorized error.

methods.name: testValidateFailsIfCredentialsAreDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that disabled credentials cause an authentication failure.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CredentialsApiAuthProvider with overridden credential retrieval and validation methods for testing.

methods.name: getDeviceCredentials
methods.description: Builds a mock AbstractDeviceCredentials object with specified type, tenant, and auth ID.

methods.name: getCredentialsObject
methods.description: Constructs a CredentialsObject with specified attributes for testing.
